definitions.explanation: To repeat a question or request because one didn't hear or understand the first time.
To listen to something again, especially to music or audio recordings, to hear it better or with fresh ears.

examples.japanese: すみません、もう{一度|いちど}{聞|き}き{直|なお}してもいいですか。
examples.english: Sorry, may I ask you again?

examples.japanese: {名前|なまえ}がよく{聞|き}こえなかったので、{聞|き}き{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I couldn't hear the name well, so I asked again.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}の{曲|きょく}を{聞|き}き{直|なお}すと{懐|なつ}かしくなる。
examples.english: When I re-listen to old songs, I feel nostalgic.

examples.japanese: インタビューの{録音|ろくおん}を{聞|き}き{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I listened to the interview recording again.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB: {聞|き}く (to listen/ask) + {直|なお}す (to redo, to do again) = to listen/ask again

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive. Takes を when there is a specific object being listened to again.

CONJUGATION (godan verb):
・{聞|き}き{直|なお}して (te-form)
・{聞|き}き{直|なお}した (past)
・{聞|き}き{直|なお}せる (potential)
・{聞|き}き{直|なお}される (passive)

RELATED ～{直|なお}す COMPOUND VERBS:
・{言|い}い{直|なお}す - to say again, to rephrase
・{書|か}き{直|なお}す - to rewrite
・{見|み}{直|なお}す - to reconsider, to look at again
・{読|よ}み{直|なお}す - to reread
・やり{直|なお}す - to redo

USAGE NOTE: When asking someone to repeat what they said, {聞|き}き{返|かえ}す is also used and emphasizes the interactive exchange. {聞|き}き{直|なお}す can be used both for asking someone to repeat and for listening to recordings again.
